create_fictitious_play: create a FictitiousPlay instance to compute Nash equilibrium approximations for a mean field game
run_fictitious_play_iteration: run a single FictitiousPlay iteration to update the policy via best response and weighted averaging
get_fictitious_play_policy: get the current merged policy from a FictitiousPlay instance after running iterations
build_merged_policy: build a MergedPolicy that combines multiple policies weighted by their distributions
run_fictitious_play_softmax: run FictitiousPlay with a softmax temperature parameter instead of greedy policy updates
